nom: haruharu Black Rice Probiotics Barrier Essence

avis.titre: Great addition to my daily skin flooding
avis.texte: This essence is AMAZING! The Haru Haru Wonder Black Rice Probiotics Barrier Essence has completely upgraded my routine. The texture is dreamy—light, milky, and perfect for skin flooding. My skin drinks it up instantly and looks so radiant afterward. This is one of my favorite essences so far! My barrier feels stronger, my skin stays moisturized all day, and I’ve had zero clogged pores. It layers perfectly with serums and moisturizers. it’s vegan and gentle enough for sensitive skin. I have mature skin, and if you want plump, hydrated, glassy skin, this is absolutely worth it.

avis.titre: Exceptional Barrier Essence for Layering — Hydrating, Soothing, and Perfect for Mature SkinExceptional Barrier Essence f
avis.texte: I’m 52 with post-menopausal skin that tends to be drier and more sensitive than it used to be, so barrier support and hydration are extremely important in my routine. I’ve been using Korean skincare for many years and have tried countless essences, toners, and barrier products, but this one from Haruharu Wonder has quickly become one of my favorites for strengthening and maintaining the skin barrier. This essence is exactly the kind of product that works beautifully for that purpose. The texture is lightweight but very cushioning at the same time. It absorbs easily without feeling watery or thin, and it gives the skin that comfortable, hydrated feel that lasts rather than disappearing a few minutes later. It layers exceptionally well, which makes it ideal for the Korean skincare method of “skin flooding” or applying multiple hydrating layers. One of the things I appreciate most about this formula is how calming it is. When my skin feels a little stressed, dry, or reactive, this helps restore balance quickly. The probiotics and black rice extract seem to work together to support the skin barrier while improving overall skin resilience. After applying it, my skin feels noticeably softer and more supple. There’s a healthy glow that comes from well-hydrated skin, but it doesn’t leave any sticky or heavy residue. That’s important because I use several serums and creams afterward, and this never interferes with the rest of my routine. Over time I’ve also noticed that my skin looks

I’m writing this specifically for the probiotic barrier essence: I’m 58 with dry skin. I’ve tried the TirTir, Laniege, and Thayers. Enjoyed them all and still use the Thayers to calm my skin when irritated (love the snow mushroom in it) but this is now my #1. Not only is it incredibly soothing, but unlike the Thayers, it works great to mix with bronzing drops. I LOVE how glowy my skin looks upon application, and in the summer, some days I find that a double application of this is all I need to moisturize before sunscreen. It’s thicker than all the others I’ve tried, so takes less. I know it has all sorts of skin enhancing benefits, too. Fabulous product!!

avis.titre: A soothing milky miracle in a bottleA soothing milky miracle in a bottle
avis.texte: I noticed an improvement in my complexion beginning day one. My skin tone was brighter, more even, and the red and dark spots seemed to diminish after the first day. I also use this on the delicate skin on the back of my hands to hopefully, help them appear younger. The product texture is a smooth, watery, milky liquid that is soothing on the skin. I love this stuff! I’ve already recommended it to my daughter, and this is one product that’s a must-have for me from now on. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Amazing for post lasers, for irritated skin barriers- bought after watching doctorly!!
avis.texte: I had a series of professional lasers- frameless, moxi and bbl to address texture, laxity, pigmentation,redness/rosacea and fine lines and to just brighten by generally dull skin for some preventive and corrective as I wade theough peri into meno. My little insurance plan has left me with beautiful skin, but, my barrier is a wreck. I want to start using my actives again but each time I give it a go, the next 2-3 days I am in repair and calm mode where even a little makeup can feel irritating. I am not new to skincare by any means. I’ve been taking care of my skin for over 25 years now starting with Paula’s choice in the late 90’s early 2000’s. I am new to “skin flooding’ and k beauty. I love doctorly and dr shahs skincare line Remedy is the new Paula’s choice for me. In one of thier clips they discussed how to repair the barrier and suggested this haruharu barrier essence, cleanser and a no actives comforting moisturizer for a minuimumn of a month. It’s summer and I work from home- why not. I cannot believe how nice my skin felt when I first put this on. It felt nice to put this on. It absorbed almost completely and left a light moisturizing layer of silky feeling on my skin—- I’ve tried skin care creams that cost 350$ that did not make my skin feel like this. My skin was completely unirritated in every way. There was no jarring fragrance, just a light milky liquid in this substantial bottle. This bottle has some weight to it, it’s completly sealed from light and there is a b

This is truly not getting the hype it deserves. Its the most moisturizing, claming essence I have ever tried. I have tried a lot. It has a thick consistency which makes it feel luxurious. I use this at night with my tretinoin and it has been amazing. My skin is in the dry peeling stage of tret and this and one more product have been the cure. After washing i use this and let it sit for a min, then go in with tret, and top it off with the illiyoon ceramide cream. Thats it. My skin as never been better. Im so acne prone and this has never caused me an issue. It applies easily and just feels so good.

Ok...so I usually don't do reviews, but I HAVE to for this one! I have been looking for something to plump my skin because I am 40 and I am desperately trying to avoid LOOKING my age haha. I have only used this a couple of times, but my forehead is looking PORELESS. I looked in the mirror last night and was like wait a minute!! I do have combo/oily skin with larger pores on my cheeks - those are smaller too. I love how affordable this is too. I was contemplating the Rhode, but I just couldn't bring myself to spend the money on it being this was the first milky toner I've tried. It didn't break my bank to add to my already expensive skincare routine. I do tox my forehead, but something was missing to give it that flawless look, and this did it! It isn't greasy at all - just purely hydrated! So far, it sits very well under makeup and I don't look like an oil slick by noon. I will keep using this to see what happens in a couple of weeks, but this is already promising!

I love the Haruharu Wonder line. I've been using the gel face wash and decided to add this. Of course you can't see immediate results but this is very moisturizing and it's fragrance free, plus a low price. I gave it one star due to slight stickiness. It's not a deal breaker, I just prefer products that dry down with no residue.
Received today ✨️ Very small...but it feels great on the skin so far so good

avis.titre: Un’essenza miracolosa per una pelle radiosa e protetta
avis.texte: Ho recentemente scoperto l'essenza Haruharu Wonder Black Rice Probiotics Barrier e ne sono rimasta entusiasta. La sua consistenza cremosa e lattiginosa si assorbe rapidamente, lasciando la pelle morbida e rimpolpata senza alcuna sensazione di untuosità. Dopo un paio di settimane di utilizzo, ho notato un miglioramento significativo nell'elasticità e nell'idratazione della mia pelle. Gli ingredienti fermentati nutrono e migliorano l'elasticità della pelle, mentre i ceramidi e il pantenolo rafforzano la barriera cutanea, rendendo la pelle più luminosa e radiosa. Nonostante la sua ricchezza, l'essenza non è affatto pesante e si integra perfettamente nella mia routine quotidiana. Apprezzo particolarmente la sua formulazione priva di ingredienti artificiali, siliconi e alcol essiccante, rendendola ideale anche per le pelli più sensibili. L'essenza Haruharu Wonder Black Rice Probiotics Barrier è diventata un elemento indispensabile nella mia routine di cura della pelle, offrendo risultati visibili e una sensazione di lusso ad ogni applicazione.

avis.titre: Holy grail for dry and sensitive skin- ? still on the fence, fall into this face first
avis.texte: I get the hype now, my skin has never looked healthier from a single product, this essence made my dry, dull and sensitive skin behave again! It's feels so soothing and is made for rough stressed skin that needs extra support when using actives.! My skin is less reactive, less red and have had less breaks outs due to environmental stress. It’s rich and luxurios and absorbs in seconds, leaving a silky finish (not greasy). For me it works especially well with my base makeup. My concealer and blush melts into my skin for that “your skin but better” look.

Me ha gustado mucho esta esencia. Hidrata , es ligera , mi piel siente mucho confort y sobre todo no me deja película grasa ahora q estamos en verano se agradece mucho. Si quieres extra de hidratación, la crema con 5 ceramidas va perfecta. Tengo 40 años y tengo piel seca y sensible. Para piel madura se queda corta aunque dependería de cada caso. A mi, me van genial 🙂
omg este milky toner es SUPER HIDRATANTE LO RECOMIENDO DEMASIADO!!!! soy piel mixta y NO me saca granos, me deja la piel super hidratada, lo compraré de nuevo cuando se me acabe!!!!!

avis.titre: Me gustó que mi piel se siente hidratada.
avis.texte: Me encantó desde la primera vez que empecé a usarla mi cara se siente muy hidratada no causó ninguna alergia en mi piel, me gustó que no me deja la cara grasosa la recomiendo pero recuerda que cada piel es distinta a mí me funcionó muy bien.

avis.titre: It’s perfect to mi prep makeup
avis.texte: I love this Haruharu essence so much. It gives my skin an instant boost of hydration and makes it feel super smooth to the touch. Perfect for everyday use!
Love the product, soft on the skin and I always wake up with a super moisturized skin. Maybe it was me, but the size was super small (photo for reference)
ME ENCANTO EL PRODUCTO, ESTOY PASANDO POR UN PROCESO DE DESHIDRATACION INTENSA Y ESTE PRODUCTO ME VA DE MARAVILLA

absolutely love this product! It made my skin feel hydrated from the very first use. The texture is perfect — not too thick or too watery — and it applies so smoothly. I also really like the color and the glossy finish. The shine lasts a long time and gives my skin a healthy glow. The quality is excellent for the price, and honestly, it works just as well as higher-end products. I would definitely purchase this again and highly recommend

avis.titre: ✨The Final Piece to my Skincare Arsenal✨
avis.texte: My skin tends to be very dry and sensitive. I use tretinoin every day at the highest strength, so I always make sure to give my skin plenty of hydration. This product is an essential part of my routine, and I plan to keep using it forever. I take great care of my skin, and it’s taken a lot of effort to get it into good shape. I used to struggle with keeping my face moisturized all day long, especially by mid-afternoon when I’d start to feel it drying out. Thankfully, this product, along with my other moisturizing and barrier-protecting favorites, has finally made all the difference. HaruHaru was the final piece I needed.
10/10 I love this so much! It is so hydrating but soaks in fully in under 5 mins so I’m ready for my next step. Plumping, glowy, GET IT!

This is the single best beauty product I have ever purchased. I have very dry sensitive skin with rosacea and I needed something to add hydration to my skin. This leaves my skin so soft and smooth and has even improved my complexion and skin tone. I just purchased another bottle.
No es definitiva la puntuación. Llevo dos semanas usándolo y me ha sacado brotes y textura. No lo recomiendo para piel mixta

avis.texte: The best step in corean skin care This probiotics helps me A LOT with my skin

$10 for this tiny package is ridiculous. I knew I ordered a smaller one just to try out, but I guess it didn’t dawn on me how small it really was. I’m gonna give the product a try to see if it’s worth upgrading, but I do think a sample size could be a little less than what they charged.

avis.titre: Gave Me Red Bumps and Dermatitis
avis.texte: It caused red bumps all over my face—seborrheic dermatitis. I’m not usually sensitive to products, but I tried it twice already and the same thing happened both times. As soon as I stop using it, my skin goes back to normal. Unfortunately, I’m already past the return period, so now I’m stuck with a useless product on my vanity.
Bad, try to put on little bit near my ear to test out, scare to put all over face, and boom , small area break out so bad after 10 minutes
It’s too moisturizing, but if you have acne-prone skin, this not is for you, I have acne skin and broke me.😔 Even so, it continues been a good moisturizer milk for dry skin NO acne prone.

I have tried so many different skin care products in my pursuit to find the right one for me. As far as skin care for my face goes, anyway. I am prone to oily skin on my face, so I struggle with too much shine, skin care that is just too moisturizing for me. However, at 43 years old, I need a skin care regimen that includes moisturizer, despite my oily complexion. For the most part, I have fairly clear skin, but along with that, I am prone to redness, uneven tone, and need to maintain any anti aging as possible. This Haruharu Wonder Black Rice Probiotics Barrier Essence, may very well be my perfect moisturizer/face cream! Additionally, I want a product that does not test on animals, and thankfully, this one is Peta approved, so that's covered too. Right off , the packaging is on point. The bottle is pretty, sleek, clearly high quality materials used, even the product box is nice. It looks luxury to me, so that's a plus. This bottle is a bit different in a way through. It is much harder, and isn't one that you necessarily squeeze to get the product out. It's better to shake it out, due to the type of bottle, and the consistency of the cream being rather thin. It's white in color, but is a bit more liquidy than other similar products. That being said, the thinner consistency takes nothing away from its hydrating and moisturizing ability. This product is easy to apply, has a very cool/cooling feel, and it's extremely moisturizing, while NOT being heavy or oily. When first applie

This product is amazing. It comes in a sealed, beautiful, heavy bottle that you shake well before using. After preparing it, you shake out a few drops and pat it on your skin for some instant magic. The milky essence is immediately absorbed into the skin, resulting in a smooth, hydrated surface and skin that instantly looks more plump and firm. This haruharu toner can be used on all skin types, and even my ultra sensitive skin found it to be gentle and soothing, with absolutely no irritation. There is no offending scent. I have been impressed with several of the new Korean skin care products, but this one really blew me away. It made a real difference in my tired, dry skin, giving it a luminescence I really didn't expect. I am thrilled to have found this product to add to my skin care regimen. Of note: the expiration date is three years out, a really nice bonus.

This haruharu wonder Black Rice Probiotics Barrier Essence is hydrating and feels soothing on my skin. It has a great list of skin positive ingredients and my normally irritated skin looked less inflamed after using this for a few days. This essence has a milky texture and the bottle needs to be shaken up before using it. It does not have an added fragrance to it (which I appreciate). It feels luxurious and lightweight on my skin, absorbing easily and without leaving a sticky feeling behind. My skin looks smoother and more glowing.

avis.titre: Wonderfully soothing; makes my skin so soft!
avis.texte: I'm been using this essence after cleansing and before applying serums or moisturizer. It has a light milky look and feel. I don't notice any scent to speak of. It absorbs readily --you don't need to use a lot. It instantly make my skin look better. It actually looks radiant. Once the product is fully absorbed my skin feels soft and velvety. I don't think I expected this to make a noticeable difference, but I'm impressed. It's a pretty good sized bottle too, so this should last a while.

This is quite soft and you're able to use it in a thin layer that absorbs very well and isn't sticky or oily after a short time. The bottle itself feels very premium because it isn't a soft plastic bottle. It's heavy and feels like ceramic. I'm not sure about the material but it feels more like a reusable bottle over a disposable one. Good size and is a genuine Korean product.

This stuff is amazing. Thicker than Rhode’s glazing milk and honestly works better. It makes my skin feel so soft and prepared for the next skincare steps. Hydrating and gives you that glass skin look. I love stuff this so much. I’m so glad I went for it! Highly recommend✨

I have STRUGGLED to find a good, gentle, and hydrating essence for a while but can I say, this is amazing?!? My skin feels very hydrated and smooth, almost silky when I put it on. I really like this brand because I’ve only had positive experiences. Great for black skin! I also own the moisturizer from this line and the black rice sunscreen one!

avis.titre: Didn’t Expect It to Be This Good, My Skin Looks Like Glass Now!
avis.texte: A Korean friend of mine, who honestly has the most flawless skin I’ve ever seen, recommended this essence to me. When she told me she was 50 (and I thought she was in her 30s!), I knew I had to try her skincare secret — and I’m so glad I did. This Haruharu Wonder Black Rice Essence feels luxurious from the first use. The glass bottle looks and feels high-end, and the texture is this silky, milky essence that absorbs fast and leaves your skin soft and glowy — not sticky at all. After just a couple of weeks, my skin barrier felt stronger, and the glow was unreal. My skin looks smooth, hydrated, and healthy — like that “glass skin” finish you only see in K-beauty routines. It layers perfectly under other skincare and even makeup. If you love products that make your skin look alive again, this one’s a keeper. Subtle at first, but the results build beautifully. Definitely worth it!

The absolute best product I’ve ever bought! It works so great even from the first use. I’ve spent thousands of dollars on skincare and this is the absolute best purchase. My skin was so hydrated and glow my right from the first use. Sooooo happy I found this product.

Amazing toner that moisturizes and plumps the skin. Fantastic for priming before makeup or getting an extra moisture boost at bedtime, especially for my dry/dehydrated skin. I genuinely love this product except for one major qualm, the packaging. First, it was really difficult to open. Next, the cap cracked and I had to tape it. Finally, this happened (photo attached). The top broke off, the bottle fell, and glass went everywhere. I’m still using the remaining product because of how good it is but something needs to be done about the packaging smh

avis.titre: Tiny but goes a long way
avis.texte: So tiny and convenient for my trip coming up I can put in a travel bag with my other skincare! Formula is very thick and creamy not watery or slippery. Made my all over skin texture feel very soft and hydrated. Will repurchasing bigger version.

This essence is absolutely amazing and has become a staple in my skincare routine. The texture is lightweight yet deeply hydrating and it absorbs so quickly without leaving any sticky or greasy feeling on my skin. After just a few weeks of consistent use my skin feels smoother plumper and more resilient with a healthy glow that I notice every morning. I have sensitive skin and this product calms redness and irritation while strengthening my moisture barrier which has made a huge difference. The probiotic and black rice formula feels luxurious and gives me long lasting hydration that lasts all day. I love how soft and supple my skin feels and makeup applies flawlessly over it. The packaging is sleek and easy to use and a little goes a long way so the bottle lasts a good amount of time. I would recommend this to anyone who wants a reliable essence that truly transforms the skin. This is a five star product that I will definitely keep repurchasing.
Amazing product. Leaves your face moisturized and smooth. This is like a cup of water for my face. Definitely recommend . I will say the bottle is a little heavy though.

When I say I love this I absolutely love this product! I’ve been very against using multiple products so I stuck to my vanicream face wash and moisturizer due to my sensitive skin (from a period of over exfoliating my skin when I was younger). Adding this to my routine has done wonders. My skin feels plump and hydrated. I will say the first couple days took time to adjust because I don’t like having a sticky looking face. My skin adjusted and it looks wonderful now. Highly recommend. Ps those are just veins I have on my face not a byproduct of using this product.
